notes: VCA301: the Updates tile now glows GREEN (was amber) when a new version is available — a positive 'ready to install' cue, distinct from amber/red warnings. VCA300 refinements (Buyer Print Due List column-flow): a split card no longer orphans a lone 'முன்:' line in a nearly-full column (it starts in a fresh column with the opening + first days), and any chunk that continues in the next column now shows a 'தொடர்கிறது →' footer under its last total so a mid-card subtotal isn't mistaken for the final balance.
